articles.summary: Longtime exhibitor returns with a unified fresh and shelf-stable portfolio following the brand’s reunification after nearly 40 years; six new products debut at booth #1642 Del Monte Corporation (NYSE:DMC), previously known as Fresh Del Monte Produce Inc., one of the world’s leading vertically integrated producers, distributors and marketers of fresh and shelf-stable food products, will return to the IFPA Global Produce Floral Show in Orlando, Fla., Oct. 15-16, with its first unified showcase of fresh and shelf-stable offerings since its acquisition of select Del Monte Foods assets. Building on the company’s longstanding presence at the show, this year’s exhibit marks a new chapter for the Del Monte ® brand, reunited under one global owner for the first time in nearly 40 years. articles.summary: New Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn, made in collaboration with Hidden Valley Ranch, and Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans offer convenient, craveable ways to add bold flavor to everyday meals Del Monte Foods North America , part of Del Monte Corporation , is adding even more flavor to the center-of-store vegetable aisle with the launch of two new canned vegetable offerings: Del Monte® Ranch Flavored Whole Kernel Corn, created in collaboration with Hidden Valley™ Ranch , and Del Monte® Zesty Italian Inspired Vinaigrette Cut Green Beans. The new products expand Del Monte’s portfolio of bold-flavored canned vegetables, developed to meet growing demand for convenient, easy-to-prepare foods that deliver both flavor and value. As more consumers cook and eat at home, especially younger households seeking familiar tastes with a unique twist, Del Monte is making it easier to turn everyday vegetables into craveable sides, snacks and recipe starters. articles.summary: Del Monte Corporation (NYSE: DMC) ("Del Monte" or the "Company") today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 25, 2026. The quarter provided further evidence of Del Monte's transformation into a more diversified food platform. Six months after the acquisition of Del Monte Foods, the Company is benefiting from a stronger earnings mix, improved profitability, and greater balance across its portfolio. The acquisition has significantly expanded the scale of Prepared Foods and strengthened Del Monte's presence across fresh, refrigerated, shelf-stable, and prepared food categories. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights: Third-quarter results reflected the growing contribution of Del Monte Foods and growth in gross profit, operating earnings, and margin performance, despite ongoing foreign currency, weather-related and cost pressures across portions of the Company's fresh and agricultural operations. Hosting the call for the Company will be Mohammad Abu-Ghazaleh, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Monica Vicente, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, and Christine Cannella, Vice President, Investor Relations. Institutional investors, analysts and other members of the financial community are invited to join the live call by dialing 1 833-461-5787 (Domestic/Toll Free) or 1 585-542-9983 (International) and entering Meeting ID: 765 161 939.
